errors.quote: the normalized [Cyclic convolution](convolution.md) $f*g/T$, where $T$ counts all entries involved
errors.problem: T is left vague: read literally, 'all entries involved' could mean the entries of both operands (2T). In the paper T = rM is the number of scalar entries of one operand array: M cyclic addresses times r polynomial coefficients (paper lines 3376, 4337-4341). The bound that follows on the page is still correct.
